name: Spaceship f1b6f83a on the 2-uniform tiling k2-003
description: A period-4 spaceship on the 2-uniform tiling k2-003 (touching neighbours), 12 to 16 cells, moving one lattice step every 4 generations (c/4). It runs the same way in the 256 rules from B456/S347 to B4,5,6,7,8,9,10/S0,3,4,7,8,9,10; the scene uses the rule it was found in. The same object runs unchanged on k2-004, k3-010 and k3-016. JETCARP's soup search found it on k3-010 (seen 7 times). To our knowledge not reported before.
